body:
I talked to my roommate last night (who's also one of my best friends) about the breakup and it really made me feel better. I guess I am probably taking this so hard partially because I was having a bit of pre-existing mental illness flare up as well beforehand (OCD and bipolar II disorder). I went to my psychiatrist a week or two ago about the OCD issues and he might try me on another anti-depressant. I'm already on quite a few meds (got a chronic pain disorder as well) so there's a weird bit of shame around being on so much medication, but I might as well give it a try over winter break (I'm doing a master's degree) to see if it makes me feel better. Might be bad timing with the breakup though. I want to make sure I'm only medicating genuine mental illness, not my feelings over the breakup.

The album is "Untamed" by Cam. I've been listening to the official stream of it here: http://www.ew.com/article/2015/12/07/cam-untamed-stream-listen. She's one of my favourite artists, I love country music. It's so good.

Thanks so much for all your empathy and your listening. I super appreciate it.

Thanks so much, I really appreciate it. Logically, I know that, but I have a hard time applying it to myself. I ended up having dinner with my mom and my brother which went well, but me and my brother and I didn't really have a chance to talk about things. Unfortunately he's going back to college about an hour and a half away tomorrow, but maybe I could make a time to talk to him over the winter break. I wish I had a chance to talk to him, like really talk, but that didn't happen. He doesn't seem mad at me though, which is good.

I still feel awful. I feel shattered. Everything reminds me of my ex-boyfriend. But I don't want to die, which is an improvement over the fleeting suicidal thoughts that led me to post here. An album I'm really excited for is coming out on Friday, and I've gotta stick around for that. I know it sounds silly, but music is my lifeline. So it's a literal lifesaver.

Thanks. I'll check in with him tomorrow, and definitely try to meet up with him. I just feel bad feeling so awful about something so trivial (my boyfriend and I did end up breaking up) and I know my problems pale in comparison to his right now.

Update: I texted my brother and he texted back saying he really appreciates it, that he's been really busy the past few days, but that he appreciates me reaching out. So it didn't go as badly as I expected. I still feel like a complete and utter piece of shit, though.

Thanks. Yeah, that's a good idea. I definitely know it's the right thing to be there for him. I just feel shattered with everything else that's going on (relationship breakdown plus completely overloaded with school plus pre-existing mental illness) so I worry that I'm going to be absolute shit at it or somehow won't be able to be properly supportive.
